subject.title: All LLM API calls time out simultaneously despite APIs being reachable (multi-agent concurrency issue)

question: Should maintainers require a fresh current-main four-agent Telegram/provider reproduction before promoting any further runtime, channel, or provider transport fix for this issue?
rationale: Merged PRs now mitigate several timeout-cascade paths, but the issue's central concurrent LLM timeout collapse has not been proven fixed or still failing on current main, and the proposed remedies cross product owner boundaries.

options.title: Require Current-Main Live Repro
options.body: Keep the issue open until a current-main Telegram multi-agent run captures the remaining bottleneck with lane, provider, fallback, and polling diagnostics.

options.title: Promote Narrow Runtime Investigation
options.body: Assign a maintainer to trace remaining timeout ownership from the current source first, accepting that the repair shape may change after live proof.

options.title: Treat Mitigations As Sufficient After Verification
options.body: Close only if maintainers run the reported scenario on current main and confirm the merged fallback and lane fixes eliminate the user-visible failure.

recommendation.title: Require Current-Main Live Repro
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open until a current-main Telegram multi-agent run captures the remaining bottleneck with lane, provider, fallback, and polling diagnostics.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is cross-boundary proof and product ownership rather than a one-file bugfix, and steipete is the strongest available routing signal from related fallback/gateway history.
